_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
homeland: no fixed homeland (ambush-warrens and silent dens)

branch.regression: low growl-whispers (voiced and breathy with a sibilant whisper, h-breath, suffix -hrr/-mbu/-vurr)
branch.nature: large hairy stealth-goblinoids; silent ambushers and throat-cutters
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a bugbear's menacing whisper

_note: Beastman culture: BUGBEARS, large hairy stealth-goblinoids - Kazhur rotted into low growl-whispers (qatal 'kill' -> khatabh-hrr). Silent ambushers; they kill from the dark. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Hush / the Night-Hand). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Bugbear (Kazhur, growl-whisper regression): voiced and breathy with a sibilant whisper, h-breath after stops, suffixes -hrr/-mbu/-vurr; menacing, soft, low.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC with breathy/whispered codas; low menacing stress.

morphology.naming_marker: named in a whisper by the kashvurr; a hush-name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / ambush-band (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic. Race-totem the Hush / the Night-Hand. The Kashvurr whispers to the totem and the Gul-spirits in the silent dark; foremost Gul-Naktilu the Dark (cover for the kill); the One and the sun demonized (light reveals them).

venerated.Noctiluna (the hush-dark): Gul-Naktilu (the Dark that hides the kill; supreme)

demonized.Tulrius (the sun, light): Tarul the Burning-Eye (light that reveals the hush)

religion.shaman_rites: whisper-chants in the silent dark; the throat-offering; the donning of the shadow-hide.

holy_symbol_motifs.Night-Hand: a black hand over a closed eye

banks_patterns.war_bands: the whisper-named bands: 'the Hush', 'the Throat-cutters', 'the Night-hands of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: ambush-warrens and silent dens: 'the Creep-warren of [band]', 'the Silent hold of [chief]', 'the Throat-cutter den of [name]'
